learning_rate_schedule: 100-step warmup then cosine decay to 2e-5 over the declared maximum optimizer steps

metric_definitions.cell_accuracy_inside_true_target_rectang: target-rectangle correct cells divided by target-rectangle cell count
metric_definitions.color_nll: negative log likelihood of true colors inside hidden target rectangle
metric_definitions.exact_full_grid_accuracy: predicted shape equals hidden target shape and all cells inside the hidden target rectangle match
metric_definitions.exact_output_shape_accuracy: predicted height and width equal hidden target height and width
metric_definitions.height_nll: cross entropy against hidden target height class after inference
metric_definitions.width_nll: cross entropy against hidden target width class after inference

no_id_audit_protocol: changed external task metadata must leave model input tensors and loss-free outputs byte-identical
no_query_target_firewall_policy: hidden target tensors are not included in model_inputs_from_batch and are used only after model inference for loss/metrics

support_ablation_definitions.TRAINED_PERMUTED_SUPPORT_PAIR_ORDER: complete support input/output pairs are moved together into deterministic support-pair slots
support_ablation_definitions.TRAINED_QUERY_ONLY: attempt to set all support evidence mask entries false; if VRM rejects zero valid support keys it is reported unsupported
support_ablation_definitions.TRAINED_ZEROED_SUPPORT_OUTPUTS: support output color tokens set to color 0 while masks, roles, coordinates, pair indices, support inputs, and query input remain unchanged

validation_checkpoint_selection_rule: minimum validation mean_total_loss; sentinel metrics are not computed until selected checkpoint is frozen
